title: Verify: Frame grids, generated PNGs and removal of old SVGs
summary: Unit tests for frame sources, manifest match and no legacy SVG
description: Test grid size, palette use, slice rules, manifest/PNG sizes and absence of old SVGs.
acceptance_criteria: Grid sizes and palette indices valid
Manifest ids match PNG header sizes
No panel-frame, sound or pointer svg
technical_constraints: Unit tests only; reads committed files with node fs

steps.action: Test 'grids': for each FRAME_KIT entry assert buildFrameGrid has h rows of w cells, every value is an integer in [0, PALETTE.length), and slice*2 < min(w,h). Test 'ids': assert ids include bar, panel, plaque, parchment, slot and the four button states. Test 'determinism': two calls give toEqual grids.

Read game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json, for each FRAME_KIT id find the entry, assert dimensions equal {w,h}, and use readPngSize from src/lib/pngEncode on the file bytes at public/assets/<path> to assert it equals the dimensions. Assert ui/cursor-hand is still present. Walk game/public recursively and assert no file name matches /panel-frame|sound|pointer/ with .svg extension.
steps.expected: Manifest, PNG sizes and no-SVG assertions pass
